title: Study of Maraviroc (MVC) and Epzicom (ABC/3TC) Once-Daily in ART-Naive & First Switch Patients
brief_summary: Hypotension does not occur with Maraviroc at a dose of 600 mg/day
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Epzicom Maraviroc once daily dosing

Exclusion Criteria:

* Maraviroc with any other back bone
study_population: HIV impacted individual on therapy with once daily Maraviroc
